cards.headline:
Nine at

kitchen table
cards.body: The idea did not arrive as a business plan.

cards.name: manage-not-off
cards.headline:
We tried to
manage the
devices
cards.body: Not switch them off. A completely different job, and much harder.

cards.name: then-harder
cards.headline:
Then social
media. Then
a ban at 16.
cards.body: More screens, more accounts, more places to keep half an eye on.

cards.name: cliff-edge
cards.headline:
Nothing,
nothing,
nothing, then
everything.
cards.body: That is the cliff edge. Not the screens.

cards.name: in-between
cards.quote: Not a ban. Not no ban. The bit in between.
cards.attrib: A little more freedom at each stage, earned.

cards.name: ask
cards.headline: Keep this one
cards.save: Save it for the next time the tablet comes off and it turns into a row.
cards.send: Send it to the parent who is already dreading the summer.
